apps_side: A licence for each app on its own
faq_1_q: How do I receive my key?
faq_1_a: Once your online payment goes through, you get an email with the licence key and the download link.
faq_2_q: Can I pay cash on delivery?
faq_2_a: No. These are digital products, so payment is online only, which is what lets the key reach you right away.
faq_3_q: How many devices can I install on?
faq_3_a: The device limit is written on each app's page before you buy.
faq_4_q: The email did not arrive. What now?
faq_4_a: Check your spam folder first. If it is not there, contact us from the contact page with your order number.
footer_note: Digital products: the licence key and download link are emailed after online payment. Cash on delivery is not available.
